title: Pokemon TCG 151 sv2a Weepinbell 070/165 Pokeball Reverse Holo Japanese
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon TCG card features the character Weepinbell and is a must-have for any serious collector. With a Pokeball Reverse Holo Japanese design, this Stage 2 Pokémon card is numbered 070/165 and is a valuable addition to any collection. The card is in excellent shape and is a great investment opportunity for fans of the Pokémon TCG.
